_readme: TEMPLATE. The real file is infrastructure/secrets/account.json (gitignored) and is created from
this one the first time any script needs it. Fill it with ./infrastructure/scripts/secret.ps1 account <key>
(hidden prompt) rather than by editing, so values never pass through a clipboard history or an editor's
undo buffer. Everything here is shared by staging AND production: it describes the ACCOUNTS, not an
environment.
billing_account            gcloud billing accounts list  (XXXXXX-XXXXXX-XXXXXX)
github_app_installation_id github.com -> Settings -> Applications -> Google Cloud Build -> Configure;
the number at the end of the URL
cloudflare_account_id      Cloudflare dashboard -> partyrentalsgt.com -> Overview -> API (right column)
cloudflare_zone_id         same place
cloudflare_api_token       Cloudflare -> My Profile -> API Tokens -> Create Token -> Custom token,
named ozari-terraform-local (REBUILD.md credential register):
Account  Workers Scripts:Edit, Cloudflare Pages:Edit, Workers R2 Storage:Edit
Zone     DNS:Edit, Zone Settings:Edit, Workers Routes:Edit,
Transform Rules:Edit, Zone:Read
Zone Resources: Include -> Specific zone -> partyrentalsgt.com
Account Resources: Include -> your account
neon_org_id                Neon console -> Organization settings -> General -> Organization ID (org-...)
neon_api_key               Neon console -> Organization settings -> API keys -> Create new API key
(an ORGANIZATION key: scoped to that org only, not to your whole login)
